[1/2] Build exact sign sums in one array via recurrence

impact_assessment.benefits: Compute signed sums directly from the low-bit recurrence, preserving p-values under the 1e-12 comparison tolerance
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first p-value equivalence test, partial-credit full-tune A/B with identical decisions, full suite and strict gates; revert on any decision or p-value change
impact_assessment.risks: contract: 1-ULP sum differences absorbed by tolerance; dependency: signFlipPValue/OneSided; concurrency: process-local counter; state: none
impact_assessment.why: exactSignedSums allocated and filled two Float64Arrays when one signed-sum array suffices with an O(1) recurrence
